page.layout: One printed page, single text column, full width. Running head at top with page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: huic civitati datus Joannes Cnifius ex
ordine cucullatorum Ultrajectinus, Per-
sonae nomen munusque peremptum, ca-
nonici constituendo collegio electi, his
alendis tuendaeque episcopi dignitati cen-
sus omnes coenobii Werumani a rege ac
pontifice versi, Adoardii quoque annua
aliquot millia huc conferre coacti: coe-
nobium Fratrum domicilium episcopi
factum, Martiniana aedes cathedrali ho-
nore donata. Sed raro fato unus idem-
que primus & ultimus episcopus Gronin-
gae Cnifius fuit: quo vitâ functo, cum
annus flueret M. D. LXXII, res in priorem
statum relapsa est. Nunc abrogatâ Ro-
manensi superstitione & ἱεραρχία[?] is quo-
que statu cum caeteris corruit. Sacerdo-
tum loco introducti sunt ecclesiae mini-
stri, suffragiis ejusdem ecclesiae electi, vo-
lente & probante senatu, qui purum Dei
verbum docent, & sacramenta ex for-
ma divinitus tradita administrant duobus
in templis, ipsi numero sex: quorum
nullus potestate eminet supra caeteros,
omnes agunt aequaliter inter se, quamvis
alii alios, prout dotibus instructi orna-

page.notes: The Greek word after "&" is only partly legible in the scan (it looks like ἱεραρχία); marked [?]. Otherwise the text is clear. A faint stamp at the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is not transcribed. The catchword "tique" completes the hyphenated word "ornatique" on the next page.
